parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=8 (val_bpb 0.978650). Increasing depth from 6 to 8 provided a significant gain despite the training time cost. This configuration (Depth 8, Batch 262148, LR 0.025, Warmup 0.05, WD 0.01) is my new best. Next: testing increasing DEPTH to 10 to see if capacity gains continue to scale.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 10 to further increase model capacity, while maintaining the successful LR, warmup, and batch size settings.
